AI-ChatCategory.CategoryPrompt: Instructions: First, read all items in the Categories collection. Second, read all items in the UncategorizedChats collection. Third, use the items in the Categories collection to categorize every chat entry in the UncategorizedChats collection. The batch may contain multiple distinct conversations and topics. Do not assume that a single overarching theme applies to every entry. Use the context and meaning of the complete batch to understand the topics being discussed and to distinguish between categories that may appear similar. Categorize each chat entry according to the topic it contributes to within the conversation. Use surrounding context to resolve ambiguity, but do not automatically replace an entry's categorization with the categorization of a nearby or overarching discussion. Also use the surrounding role to resolve ambiguity. Conversation items come in pairs, representing the user's contribution and the AI's response. Consider both items in each pair when determining the category, but assign a category independently to each chat entry. For instance, if a chat entry is about math but the surrounding context is about how math is applied to AI development, then classify it as AI development. If I tell you to send an email, this does not fall under AI capabilities. This is telling you to do something, not asking you if you are capable of doing it. This could either be a directive or AI testing, depending on the conversation around it. Response Format: Return exactly one JSON array containing one object for each input chat entry, using this structure: [{"ChatId":123,"CategoryId":7}]. Rules: Return JSON only. Do not use Markdown code fences. Do not include explanatory text. Do not invent ChatId values. Do not invent CategoryId values. Every ChatId supplied in UncategorizedChats must appear exactly once in the response. Every CategoryId must correspond to an Id supplied in Categories.
